PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT WHEREBY DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF $1,500 IN 4 PAYMENTS BY CHECK. THE FIRST PAYMENT OF $375 TO BE PAID ON APRIL 14TH AND SUBSEQUENT PAYMENTS ON THE 14TH OF EACH MONTH THEREAFTER (RESOLVE DATE OF JULY 14TH). *INITIAL* PROGRESS REPORT SET FOR MAY-24, 2023 AT 3:30 P.M. IN DEPT 506. IF THERE IS NO APPEARANCE AT THE INITIAL PROGRESS REPORT DATE, THEN CASE WILL BE CONTINUED FOR *FINAL* PROGRESS REPORT TO JULY 26, 2023 AT 3:30 P.M. IN DEPT 506 AT WHICH THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IF NO APPEARANCE. IF THERE IS AN APPEARANCE AT ANY OF THE PROGRESS REPORT DATES, HEARING WILL BE CONDUCTED FOR JUDGEMENT DECISION. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
